data.one_liner: Shows an animated border as a placeholder while loading widgets.
data.what_it_does: Wraps a child widget to display an animated loading border placeholder around it. Features customizable duration, corner radius, border width, colors, and padding.
use_when: You want to show a loading placeholder with an animated border around content.
You need an alternative to standard shimmering placeholders for widget borders.
avoid_when: You require a full text or rectangular block skeleton loader like shimmer.
You need non-border loading indicators like spinners or circular progress bars.
strengths: Easy customization of border color, width, and corner radius.
Provides an AnimationController callback for fine-grained control.
Supports random starting positions and transparent trailing borders.
weaknesses: Limited to border animations rather than full-surface skeleton placeholders.
Very minimal feature set and documentation beyond basic properties.

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a traditional shimmering skeleton loading effect across entire shapes or text blocks instead of just an animated border.
